title: feat(app-shell): give PageView a console action runtime (#1605)
body:
Closes #1605 — [SDUI] Give PageView a console action runtime.

## What

Runtime pages rendered their schema straight through `SchemaRenderer` with no action runtime, so a page-level `action:button` could render but couldn't collect params, call authenticated APIs, show result dialogs, refresh, or navigate. This blocked metadata-driven app home pages (e.g. a Cloud "Create environment" primary action).

## How

Extract ObjectView's schema-action wiring into a reusable **`useConsoleActionRuntime`** hook (+ a **`ConsoleActionRuntimeProvider`** wrapper). The hook owns:

- `ActionProvider` props: context, confirm / toast / navigate / param-collection / result-dialog handlers, and the registered `api` / `flow` / `script` / `modal` handlers;
- the confirm / param / result dialogs + the paused screen-flow runner (returned as `dialogs`);
- the authenticated API/flow/server-action handlers (Bearer + tenant + cookies);
- a `refresh` callback so pages can invalidate embedded data after a successful action;
- optional object context — pages run global (object-less) actions, ObjectView binds its current object.

`ObjectView` now consumes the hook (behaviour unchanged — it also feeds the confirm/toast handlers into `useObjectActions`). `PageView` wraps its page schema in `ConsoleActionRuntimeProvider`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] PageView wraps page schemas in `ActionProvider` using the shared runtime.
- [x] A page-level `action:button` with `actionType: 'api'` collects params and calls an authenticated endpoint.
- [x] Page actions navigate the SPA / open external/new-tab URLs with the same semantics as ObjectView.
- [x] Confirm / param / result dialogs and flow screen pauses work on pages.
- [x] ObjectView keeps existing action behaviour after migration.
- [x] Tests: PageView action execution + the shared hook; ObjectView app-shell suite stays green.

Type-check ✅, lint ✅ (warnings only), targeted tests ✅. Follow-up #1606 (compact embedded object views) builds on this.
